_comment: The catalog behind the Developer Portal's SDKs and samples page.
The portal fetches this document from <DeveloperPortal.SamplesRepositoryUrl>/samples/manifest.json
and renders the `samples` array. Every other top-level property is ignored by the portal, so a
fork is free to keep its own metadata here.
`sdks` is written by .github/workflows/publish-sdks.yml: on every release it stamps the new
version onto each entry and commits the result to main. The portal does not read it today.
A `samples` entry needs `name` and an absolute HTTPS `link`; an entry missing either is dropped.
`description` and `language` are optional. The contract is documented in the platform repository

samples.name: WinkPG TypeScript client
samples.description: Generated client for the WinkPG API, published to npm. Install with npm install @winkpg/winkpg-api.

samples.name: WinkPG .NET client
samples.description: Generated client for the WinkPG API, published to NuGet. Targets net9.0.

samples.name: WinkPG Python client
samples.description: Generated client for the WinkPG API, published to PyPI. Install with pip install winkpg-api.
